text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin's name and her stellar 
performance at the Hopeful Stakes were 
deeply etched into the hearts of the 
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next target is the first leg of the 
Triple Crown route: the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with a fiercely determined Narita 
Taishin, the days leading up to the 
Satsuki Sho were about to begin...!
